description: This file defines the 'OrderResponse' class, a data transfer object representing an order response including order details, items, payment info, and timestamps. It also contains a nested class 'OrderItemResponse' for item-specific details.

classes.name: OrderResponse
classes.description: Main class representing the order response with various order details and nested item class.

classes.name: OrderItemResponse
classes.description: Nested static class representing individual order item details within the order response.
